segments.name: RUCONEST® in the U.S.
segments.description: Sells RUCONEST®, a recombinant protein replacement therapy, as an on-demand treatment for acute hereditary angioedema attacks in the United States.
segments.evidence: For the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, the sales of RUCONEST® in the U.S. market were $ 311.7 million and $ 246.6 million, respectively.

segments.name: Joenja® in the United States
segments.description: Sells Joenja®, an oral targeted inhibitor, to patients with activated phosphoinositide delta syndrome in the United States.
segments.evidence: We currently commercialize Joenja® in the United States and the United Kingdom through our own sales and marketing infrastructure.

segments.name: RUCONEST® in Europe and Rest of the World
segments.description: Sells RUCONEST® for acute hereditary angioedema attacks in Europe and the rest of the world, supporting patients where approved.
segments.evidence: Revenues of RUCONEST® in Europe and Rest of the World amounted to $ 6.2 million in 2025, $ 5.6 million in 2024 and $ 5.9 million in 2023.

segments.name: Joenja® in Europe and Rest of World
segments.description: Sells Joenja® for activated phosphoinositide delta syndrome in Europe, the United Kingdom and the rest of the world.
segments.evidence: Revenues of Joenja® in Europe and Rest of World amounted to $ 8.1 million in 2025 compared to $ 4.5 million in 2024 and $ 0.3 million in 2023.

revenueModel.text: Specialty pharmacies and other customers pay the company for RUCONEST® and Joenja®, which the company sells and distributes in the United States, Europe and the rest of the world.
revenueModel.evidence: These customers are specialty pharmacies that are specialized in distribution of pharmaceuticals in our and competitors' disease area and distribute our product.
